title: Approximate tangent planes of a C¹ piece with a lower Lipschitz bound (proof of Simon Ch. 3, 1.6 '⇒')
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, g : ℝ^n → ℝ^P a C¹ map, c ∈ ℝ^n, r ∈ ℝ and m > 0 with m|a − b| ≤ |g(a) − g(b)| for all a, b in the open ball B := B_r(c). Then for every z ∈ B, the set N := g(B) has approximate tangent space T := Dg(z)(ℝ^n) = range(fderiv ℝ g z) at g(z) in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N (g z) T): dim T = n, and ∫_{η_{g(z),s}(N)} f dH^n → ∫_T f dH^n as s ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P). Here η_{w,s}(y) = s^{-1}(y − w) and H^n = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (c : Euclid n) (r m : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ ball c r, ∀ b ∈ ball c r, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖g a - g b‖) → ∀ z ∈ ball c r, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (g '' ball c r) (g z) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
